blocks.arabic_text: فَسُنُّوا عَلَيَّ التُّرَابَ سَنّاً ثُمَّ أَقِيمُوا حَوْلَ قَبْرِي قَدْرَ مَاتُنْحَرُ جَزُورٌ وَيُقْسَمُ لَحْمُهَا حَتَّي أَسْتَأْنِسَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْظُرَ مَاذَا أُرَاجِعُ بِهِ رُسُلَ رَبِّي.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب كون الاسلام يهدم ماقبله.....، رقم:٣٢١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ibn Shimasah Mahri (RH) says: We were beside Hazrat Amr ibn al-As (RA) at the time of his death. He had turned his face towards the wall and was sobbing and weeping. His son comforted and consoled him, saying, “My dear father, did the Prophet ﷺ not give you such and such good news? Did he not give you such and such glad tidings? He has told you the glad tidings of the blessings that you are to receive! That being so, why should you grieve? On hearing this, he turned his face and said, “The highest of what we have prepared for the Hereafter is the testimony that there is none worthy of worship except Allah, and that Muhammad ﷺ is His Messenger. In my lifetime I have passed through three kinds of periods. At one time there was no one who hated the Prophet ﷺ more than I did. I had a great desire that, if I got the opportunity, I would kill him somehow. This was the worst period of my life. (May Allah protect us!) Had I died in that state, I would certainly have been one of the people of Jahannam.

blocks.text: Then Allah made it dawn in my heart that Islam is the true religion. I came to the Prophet ﷺ and requested, I want to make a pledge with you.
